items.title: One Block!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Love one block? Every time the block breaks it's replaced with a new block!

items.title: One Block One Hundred Days!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Survive 100 days in One Block Skyblock! Every time the block breaks it is replaced by another one. As the days pass, more One Blocks will spawn and events will happen!

- Great vlogs!

items.title: Furniture
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: This is it! The FURNITURE for you! Have this for yourself with modern furniture so you do NOT have to have those stairs as chairs! Our furniture is in different colors, and our furniture tools let you customize them!

items.title: Skyblock!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
It's Skyblock! 

- Survive in the sky and use your small amount of blocks to survive this skyblock world!

items.title: Japanese Gods!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Powerful and ethereal Japanese Gods have awakened!
Dress as the almighty gods of ancient feudal Japan with this unique pack!

+ 10 HD skins
+ 1 free HD skin
+ Includes amaterasu, tengu, and thunder god skins!

items.title: Animal Ghosts
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Check out these animal ghosts; the petrifying parrot, the creepy cat, the frightful fox! Get ready for Halloween and scare your friends with these floaty horror skins!

- Ten scary skins
- One skin free

items.title: Anime Idols 2
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Do you like animes as much as we do? If yes, you will fall in love with these skins!

-12 different skins
-perfect for roleplay
-have fun!

items.title: PvP Stars
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you like PvP in Minecraft? If so don't wait any longer, this pack is perfect for you! Choose your favorite skin and start fighting with other players now!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay
+ Perfect for PvP

items.title: Halloween Party
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Do you want to be part of a legend? Come to this Halloween party and meet all the famous classics. Its going to be a thrill!

items.title: Fall Bash
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Fall is just around the corner. Put on your favorite sweater or jacket and go on a stroll in the cool Fall breeze or go to the pumpkin patch and meet the pumpkin king!

items.title: DannyIsDahBomb Fashion
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Join famous YouTuber DannyIsDahBomb's Minecraft's squad and become a popular teen today!
Gather your friends and let the fun begin!

+ 12 skins, bringing the freshest fashion of DannyIsDahBomb to all your worlds!
+ Browse through all the unique versions of your favourite youtuber!
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: Block Masks
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Get your head out of the sand - and put the sand on your head! 

*12 block masks
*2 skins free

items.title: Luckyblock Teens
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Test your luck with these awesome Luckyblock Teens skins! Trendy colorful outfits for your adventures!

- Lucky Block skins
- Bright outfits
- By KA Studios

items.title: Pixel Farm
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Oink, Moo, Meow, Woof! What's that? The entire farm has arrived! You can pick your role inside the farm from pigs and sheep to cows and farmers. Suit up and get ready to play with your friends! Choose from 15 different skins. Go ahead and start your new adventure!

+ 13 animal skins
+ 2 farmer skins
+ By Agora Studios

items.title: Animals Wearing Suits
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Do you like animals? Do you like wearing cool and modern attire? If your answer is yes, then you'll love Animals in Suits! These awesome outfits are ready for you to roleplay and rule the world. Now that the suits are on, let the fun begin! 

+ 10 unique skins
+ By Bluend Studios

items.title: Highlands
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
This is Highlands, a town built on top of the steepest mountains with a gorgeous palace in the center. Explore the hills, and make it your own home! Start a new great adventure, you won't regret having the best views from the top of the palace. 

+ By Agora Studios

items.title: Mystery Village
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Start your survival adventure in the Mystery Village! Explore the new civilization, discover hidden secrets, and gather loot!

+ Unique village to explore
+ Hidden loot chests

items.title: Tropical Island
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
It's very hot out, isn't it? How about you take advantage of this climate and come to explore the coolest tropical island ever? Enjoy what this island has to offer and see if you can get past the parkour lying around the island.

+ Perfect map for roleplay 
+ By Eco Studios

items.title: Rich Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
It's time to hit the city as a rich teen. Dress up and roleplay as one of 12 new, cool skins and show them off to your friends.

+ 12 unique skins.
+ Stand out from the rest.

items.title: Extra Twin Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Can't have enough twinsies these days! Found a matching set of clothes for your bestie yet? Don't worry! We got you covered! Twinsie vibes coming right up!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Cute attire inspired by twins!

items.title: Diamond Boss
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Diamonds are one of the hardest substances in the world. Only a few things can dare test its strength. So, adventurer beware. Tread carefully for the diamond boss is near.

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Final boss attire inspired by diamonds!

items.title: Epic Dragons
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
The most epic dragons are here, and you can ride them! Shoot lightning at mobs or rain TNT down from the skies, what dragon will you choose?

+ An epic survival spawn with an elemental theme
+ Tame a dragon as a pet
+ Dragon scale textured Elytra
+ 5 Dragons that have active and passive abilities

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Giant Spider Survival
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Giant mutated spiders have taken over Minecraft! You're tasked with saving it, can you do it?

- Custom mob attacks!
- Huge custom terrain!
- Giant mobs!
- Licensed by 5 Frame Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Magic Skies Castle
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Take your mining and crafting to the skies in this medieval-themed skyblock world of magical floating islands! Have an adventure in a castle up high! Navigate the islands in creative ways while searching for loot.

-Comfy terrain and relaxing environment.
-Islands with plenty of loot.
-Enjoy exploring on your own or with friends!
